name: Decal_Blood_Drips_01
class: decal (alpha decal texture set; no mesh)

textures.channels: base colour sRGB + opacity in alpha
tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic (0)

material_exception: decal set private to this decal; a deferred decal cannot use the tiling library sets of ART_STANDARD.md section 2
source_note: the source is the height field generated by the build script (seeded, deterministic); the .blend holds the review scene with the decal blended over the ground
origin_ids_note: the family shares its origin IDs between all of its frames; this decal dresses the placements that show frame 187/2
dresses: four separate thick drips, 6 to 11 cm, with a few satellites
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: A flat decal: pooled blood has no real meniscus or parallax, only a normal map, so at a grazing 1 m view the thick pools read thinner than they are. Opacity is authored for a mid-toned ground; on very dark ground the soaked halo disappears, on pale stone it reads strong. The sets are static: no drying over time, no interaction with the ground relief (blood does not run into cracks or round pebbles). Unreal decal material (DBuffer, opacity from BC alpha) is not built here.
